fr.short: Philosophie de collaboration entre développement et opérations pour livraison rapide
fr.full:
La **culture DevOps** est une philosophie de collaboration entre développement et opérations pour livrer rapidement et fiablement.

**Piliers CALMS** : Culture (collaboration), Automation, Lean (flux), Measurement (métriques), Sharing (partage).

**Pratiques** : CI/CD, IaC, monitoring, blameless post-mortems, ownership bout-en-bout, feedback loops courts.

**Transformation** : plus que des outils — changement de mentalité, équipes cross-fonctionnelles, responsabilité partagée, amélioration continue.

en.short: A philosophy of collaboration between development and operations for fast delivery
en.full:
**DevOps culture** is a philosophy of collaboration between development and operations to deliver quickly and reliably.

**CALMS pillars** : Culture (collaboration), Automation, Lean (flow), Measurement (metrics), Sharing.

**Practices** : CI/CD, IaC, monitoring, blameless post-mortems, end-to-end ownership, short feedback loops.

**Transformation** : more than tools — a change of mindset, cross-functional teams, shared responsibility, continuous improvement.
